justification: `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/JavaParserAdapter.java` is a broad adapter with 30+ public parse methods and many outgoing dependencies: it imports and delegates across `JavaParser`, `JavadocParser`, `ParseResult`, `ParseProblemException`, `ParserConfiguration`, and a large set of AST node types. Fan-in is also high: `rg -l "JavaParserAdapter"` found 25 dependent files besides the class itself, including production `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/StaticJavaParser.java` and 24 test classes across `javaparser-core-testing` and `javaparser-symbol-solver-testing`.
